metadata.title: Mahamadou Nouridine | Full Stack Software Engineer
metadata.description: Full Stack Software Engineer with 3+ years building production web applications and mobile backends. Expert in RESTful APIs, multi-tenant SaaS, AWS and React/Next.js.

about-page.about: I'm a Full Stack Software Engineer with over 3 years of professional experience building and maintaining production web applications and the backends behind mobile clients. I work across the whole delivery cycle — RESTful API design, multi-tenant SaaS, configurable backend frameworks, relational and NoSQL databases and AWS deployments, on the front-end side with React, Next.js and Blazor. I'm comfortable owning design decisions, reviewing everything that ships, and collaborating with product managers and designers in Agile, cross-border teams. I also bring AI coding assistants into my workflow for prototyping, debugging, code review support and documentation, while staying accountable for the final result.
